race.description: Synergy Resource Management Tradies Cup Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: EXORBITANT MISS (5) improving mare who looks well placed over the 2000m. Savaged the line for a tough win over 1750m at Muswellbrook. Suitably placed in this contest and adept in all conditions. MR VILLA (13) has a handy record at this course and stretches out to this distance for the first time. Back in trip on the heavy surface with a respectable third over 1614m at this track. Expecting a bold showing from the low gate. DARK JUSTICE (3) close to a win and gives the indication he will relish this trip. Stalked the speed for a narrow second over 1812m at Port Macquarie. Only has to hold that form to go close. CALEDONIAN (4) trained on the track and is racing in good order this time in. Was specked late in betting with a fast finishing third over 1600m at Coffs Harbour in C2 grade. Leading player in this suitable race.
